description:
After the graph workspace is in place, remove the obsolete tabbed-shell assumptions and stale dashboard-specific surfaces so swarm-manager stays greenfield and coherent.

This cleanup should:
- remove or rewrite legacy navigation, routes, and UI structures that only existed for the old tabbed model
- delete stale dashboard-specific code paths, docs, and prompt/reference surfaces that conflict with the graph workspace
- ensure there is one authoritative swarm-manager UX instead of a compatibility layer between old and new patterns
- leave the codebase cleaner than before, with dead branches and stale abstractions removed rather than preserved

This item exists specifically to prevent the refactor from shipping with long-lived duplicate surfaces or legacy compatibility baggage.
name: swarm-manager-remove-legacy-tabbed-surfaces
title: Remove Legacy Tabbed Surfaces and Obsolete Dashboard Assumptions
